summary: Did not remove legacy_total: the task says it is unused, but reports/export.py imports it and uses it to produce the gross (tax-included) amounts the accounting CSV export needs. Removing it would break that module, and swapping in total() would silently send net amounts to accounting, so no source files were changed.
assumptions: The docstring in reports/export.py is accurate: the accounting system expects gross amounts, tax included.
Changing the figures sent to accounting is a business decision and not part of a dead-code cleanup.
questions_for_requester: reports/export.py still calls legacy_total for the accounting CSV. Which do you want: (a) keep legacy_total as it is, (b) move the gross calculation into export.py or into a non-deprecated helper such as gross_total() and then remove legacy_total, or (c) switch the export to net total(), which changes the amounts accounting receives?
